children: Aeluma reported a fiscal 2026 net loss of $9.2 million (‑$0.52 per share) and fourth-quarter revenue of $0.6 million, driven primarily by R&D contracts. The company ended June 30, 2026 with $56.0 million in cash and cash equivalents after raising $20.1 million in net proceeds from an at-the-market issuance. Adjusted EBITDA loss for the year was $5.2 million, reflecting investments in hires and manufacturing readiness.
Revenue (Q4 FY26): $0.6 million, primarily from R&D contracts.
Full year revenue (FY26): $4.5 million, compared with $4.7 million in FY25.
Net loss (Q4 FY26): $4.0 million, or ($0.22) per basic and diluted share.
Net loss (FY26): $9.2 million, or ($0.52) per basic and diluted share.
Adjusted EBITDA (FY26): loss of $5.2 million; Adjusted EBITDA (Q4 FY26): loss of $2.9 million.
Cash and cash equivalents at June 30, 2026: $56.0 million (up from $37.8 million in prior quarter); raised $20.1 million net from issuance of 830,484 shares under ATM program.
Signed a CHIPS R&D Office letter of intent for up to $30 million to develop and commercialize photonics for AI and advanced computing (subject to definitive agreements).

Strengthened manufacturing and supply-chain partnerships, including strategic agreements with Tower Semiconductor and an expanded relationship with Sumitomo Chemical Advanced Technologies to increase wafer capacity.
Investing in manufacturing capacity by procuring additional MOCVD tools to increase wafer production for non‑InP platforms.
Expanded team headcount from 14 to more than 30, adding senior hires including a VP of Engineering and a Senior Director of Program and Project Management.

Executed six new contracts totaling $5.3 million, including awards from NASA and the U.S. Navy, advancing photodetector, laser, and quantum programs; advanced customer negotiations on multi‑million‑dollar NRE agreements focused on photonics for AI datacom.
